// TEMPORARY deployment mirror for external provider sources — generated by
// the provider scaffold from the resolved "shared" runtime profile.
//
// Why this file exists: the pinned @apifuse/provider-sdk does not pass a
// `deployment` key through defineProvider(), and external polyrepo sources
// never run the monorepo AST lint that catches the misplacement, so the
// platform's materialization contract
// (scripts/provider-deploy/materialize-provider.mjs) requires deploy.ts at
// the repository root until the SDK deployment passthrough lands
// (unify-provider-manifest-dx task 1.1). Without it the repository is
// PROVIDER_REPO_NOT_BOOTSTRAPPED and its first deploy fails.
//
// Keep these values in sync with any `deployment` intent in index.ts.
// Delete this file only when the SDK passthrough ships and the platform
// drops the requirement.
export default {
  "runtime": "shared",
  "language": "typescript",
  "replicas": 1,
  "hpa": {
    "enabled": true,
    "minReplicas": 1,
    "maxReplicas": 1,
    "targetCPUUtilizationPercentage": 70
  },
  // korea-corporate-info idles at ~63Mi but is OOMKilled on a ~30-minute cycle
  // (13 restarts in 6.5h observed 2026-08-04): the periodic corporate-code
  // catalog fetch/parse exceeded 384Mi while building a full XML object tree.
  // Incremental row extraction removes that tree; 512Mi preserves operational
  // headroom for the ZIP, decoded XML string, and retained entries array.
  "resources": {
    "cpu": "25m",
    "memory": "512Mi"
  }
};
